about.name: MUHAMMAD FEBRIANSYAH
about.bio:
As an Informatics Engineering graduate with a strong interest in Software Engineering and Web Development, I enjoy building web applications that solve practical problems. 

 I have hands-on experience creating web-based systems, including security reporting and pensioner membership monitoring applications. I am passionate about learning new technologies and developing efficient, user-friendly, and secure software solutions.

description: Developed a web-based Security Report application to support security reporting and information management.
Contributed to designing and implementing application features based on organizational requirements.
Built functional and user-friendly web interfaces to support reporting workflows.
Collaborated with team members to ensure the application met operational needs and requirements.
Designed and developed a web-based pensioner membership monitoring system.
Implemented AES-256 encryption to protect sensitive personal information.
Built features for pensioner data management, document administration, and attendance monitoring.
Implemented role-based access control and audit logging to support application security and activity tracking.
